structural_interpretation: A word-sized $M_SIZE at +2 and CR/LF at +4, followed by return address and saved message number, explains the target offsets. The baseline byte-sized $M_SIZE and saved class byte between CR/LF and return address do not match this local layout.
limitations: Symbols are inferred from matching operations; probe validates relative offsets but not the target data initialization.
Absence or relocation of the baseline saved-class byte has not been proven across all code paths.
Full $M_RES_ADDRS structure and the use of the subsequent word are unverified.

replacement_count_and_divisor.interpretation: SYSDISPMSG copies CX to BP; display-message saves BP, compares parsed substitution number to the saved word, uses the saved count in subsequent indexing, and clears it. The next word is used as a divisor.
limitations: $M_REPLACE_CNT is a descriptive probe name; the original symbol name is unknown.
The probe establishes matching field offsets, not source provenance or initialization bytes.
Some code paths and surrounding structures are still unverified.
